_note: The models the session queue may route to. checked_at is when this file was last compared with the source pages; the morning check re-reads them when it is more than 7 days old and reports any difference. Never route to a model that is not listed here.

models.use_for: mechanical, fully specified changes: a rename, a status flip, a copy edit, a one-file docs change, a queue entry update
docs-only bundles, specified UI copy, small fixes with a named file and test, feedback items with clear answers
anything in src/ that needs judgment, any migration, verification that will be relied on, multi-file features with every unknown answerable from the tree

models.price_per_mtok: $10 in / $50 out (separate weekly Fable limit on his plan)
models.use_for: only where the session must decide what the prompt could not specify: undocumented subsystem, port between repos, repo-wide sweep, first-draft architecture, irreversible operation. Always needs his go

notes: Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to medium effort in Claude Code (model-config page); Sonnet 5.5 defaults to high on the API page. A queue entry always states its effort, so defaults never decide.
ultracode is a Claude Code setting, not an effort level: xhigh plus orchestrated workflows. It needs his go.
max is accepted per session but not in settings files.
